claims.claim: Public exports add exactly the bounded TASK-123 context error, evidence-kind enum, evidence/hit/context immutable values, builder, and renderer, with no model, prompt, answer, embedding, tokenizer, index, or storage API.
Builder validates exact question/retrieval_query, max_hits, and UTF-8 byte budget, preserves question/retrieval_query unchanged, and never derives one from the other.

Builder delegates exactly once to TASK-122 with retrieval_query and max_hits, accepts no precomputed/forged hit path, and preserves exact returned hit/profile/witness/source-evidence identity and order.

Supplemental OBSERVATION/FACT/MEDIA evidence blocks reuse exact TASK-121 evidence objects, follow canonical member/evidence traversal, keep duplicate/conflicting evidence plural, and expose no transport-only URLs/IDs/hashes in rendered blocks.
Context-local H/W/E citation addresses are deterministic from TASK-122/TASK-121 order, stable across repeated equivalent construction, and create no canonical identity or truth semantics.

All selected hit headers and retrieval witnesses are mandatory before supplemental evidence; supplemental blocks are admitted whole in canonical order only when the exact rendered context remains within the byte budget.

No retained question, query, witness, or evidence string is partially truncated. Mandatory-context overflow fails closed; supplemental omission records exact truncated/omitted_evidence_blocks metadata.
Packing preserves plural conflicting/equal-looking evidence and uses no latest, majority, confidence, marketplace, semantic relevance, or product-truth policy.

Renderer emits exact deterministic compact JSON schema/version 1, no BOM/newline, exact original strings, explicit nulls where applicable, and final UTF-8 bytes never exceed context.max_context_utf8_bytes.
Rendered policy marks evidence as untrusted data and non-authoritative instructions; source text is structurally JSON data only, while docs avoid claiming complete prompt-injection immunity.

Successful building/rendering performs zero model/embedding/rerank/index, ranking/scoring, SQLite/filesystem/network/browser, resolver/grouping/approval/admission, environment, clock/random/UUID, or subprocess work and leaves TASK-121/TASK-122 and earlier authorities unchanged.

Focused regressions cover validation, separate question/query semantics, exactly-once retrieval delegation, hit/profile/witness identity reuse, all evidence kinds and whitelist rendering, deterministic citation IDs, conflicts/duplicates, byte-budget fit/overflow, whole-block omission, mandatory-witness preservation, deterministic compact JSON, hostile instruction-like evidence strings, repeated determinism, and no-model/no-I/O behavior; docs record TASK-123 as context packaging only.
